events.content:
Implemented a complete, account-free reading tracker.

Features include:

- Home shelf split into “Currently reading” and “Finished”
- Add-book form with title, author, notes, and validation
- Mark books as finished
- Individual book pages with shareable URLs
- One-click “Copy link” button
- JSON persistence in [books.json](/workspace/data/books.json)
- Responsive desktop/mobile design
- Helpful empty states and 404 page

Run it with:

```bash
npm start
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.

Key files: [server.js](/workspace/src/server.js), [store.js](/workspace/src/store.js), [views.js](/workspace/src/views.js), and [styles.css](/workspace/public/styles.css).

Verification passed:

- `npm test` — 2 end-to-end tests
- `npm run build`
- Confirmed books remain available after a server restart
- Confirmed live HTML and CSS responses return successfully
